{{Quote|Eeth's talents were great&mdash;as was his heart. He was a great Jedi and a good friend. I loved him then, and love him still.|[[Sharad Hett]], to [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|<ref name="SWRO">''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]''</ref>}}
'''Eeth Koth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], and member of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonian]] Zabrak such as Eeth Koth were renowned for their mental discipline, which allowed them to tolerate great physical suffering. This ability was born of surviving their harsh environment. Koth was born in the violent slums of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and was deemed too old to begin Jedi training at age four.

His natural abilities were his ticket into the Jedi Order, and Koth would go on to become a leading member of the Jedi Council. Koth participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the opening battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as part of the [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Geonosis strike team]] consisting of 200 Jedi. Koth narrowly survived a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] gunship crash which took the life of [[Tarados Gon/Legends|Tarados Gon]], and was initially believed to be dead following the battle. After returning to his duties, Koth would go on to lead his men in the [[Battle of Korriban (Clone Wars)|Battle of Korriban]]. A chance encounter with the [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], led to his [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|capture]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. However, using [[Sign language/Legends|sign language]] hidden in a holotransmission sent to the Jedi Council by Grievous, Koth led the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] to his location over [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] freed Koth from his imprisonment, though not without escaping a trap by Grievous. In the final hours of the Clone Wars, Koth was present at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] when it was [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attacked]] by the newly-anointed Darth Vader, and Koth fell in defense of the Temple.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Born into the violent slums of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the young Zabrak Eeth Koth lived as an orphan for the first years of his life. At the age of four, Koth was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and exceptionally strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Brought to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by a representative of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] was reluctant at first to accept him based on his age. However after further examination the Council reconsidered based on the boy's determination and clarity of mind.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Inducted in the [[Jedi academy|academy]] at the Temple, Koth [[Initiate Trials/Legends|graduated]] and was selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by the esteemed [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Kosul Ayada]].<ref name="TEVD" /> Over the course of their time together, Master Ayada honed the young Zabrak's natural talents with the Force and tested his strength of will and resistance to pain. After years of travel together and the successful completion of countless missions, Master Ayada petitioned the Council to allow the boy to take the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]]. Passing the Council's tests Koth was [[Knighting Ceremony/Legends|knighted]] as a Jedi and eligible to accept solo missions that would take him across the stars.<ref name="TCSWE" />

As a Jedi Knight, Koth chose to enhance his already formidable skills with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] by studying as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]]. Constructing a lightsaber with a green blade, Koth's weapon bore similarities to the hilt of his late master, who became one with the Force soon after Koth's knighthood.<ref name="TEVD" /> Taking on the most dangerous missions that came from the High Council, Koth undertook long journey-missions on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Eventually Koth was recognized by the High Council for his exceptional skills with the Force and a lightsaber and was appointed to the esteemed rank of Jedi Master.<ref name="DB" />

===Jedi Master===
As a Master, Eeth Koth took on the young [[Sharad Hett]] as his Padawan. Passing down his skills to Hett, the duo were assigned to far-flung worlds to quell civil war and dethrone tyrants. While Koth would have liked to allow Hett time to return to his homeworld to spend time with his birth family, both were far too loyal to the Order to turn down the constant stream of missions they were assigned. After Koth trained his student to knighthood in [[47 BBY/Legends|47 BBY]], Jedi Hett told his former mentor of his great longing to return to his homeworld. Petitioning the Council to allow for a leave of absence, Master Koth bid farewell to his friend and student for the last time as Hett exiled himself to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] once he learned of his family's murder.<ref name="SWRO" />

Appointed to the High Council himself sometime during this period, Master Koth continued to accept extremely dangerous missions as he grew older. Accompanying fellow Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] in a mission during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], Master Koth fought in the [[Fifth Battle of Qotile]] during the conflict.<ref name="Star Wars 1998 39">[[Star Wars (1998) 39|''Star Wars'' (1998) 39]]</ref>

====Yinchorri Uprising====
[[File:Eeth_Koth_and_Adi_Gallia_on_Yitheeth.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and Eeth Koth repel an ambush by [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] on [[Yitheeth]].]]
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] Master Koth was one of ten Jedi that volunteered to travel to the [[Yinchorri system]] to quell the [[Yinchorri Uprising|uprising]] there. Assigned to one of three groups, Master Koth joined fellow Masters [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]], and Padawan [[Theen Fida]] as they approached [[Yitheeth]] in search of the rumored [[Yinchorri command center|command center]]. Acting as traders peddling plans for the new [[T-21 hyper particle exchange chamber]], the group was [[Ambush on Yitheeth|ambushed]] by [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] immediately upon their arrival. Defeating their opponents the group was able to capture a fleeing [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]], [[Olmar Grahrk]] and take him aboard their ship as they rushed to rescue Masters [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Micah Giiett]] on [[Yibikkoror]].<ref name="JCAOW">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War]]''</ref>

Piloting the only remaining [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class space cruiser]], the group headed to [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]] to rescue Master Windu's task force. Landing on the planet in the midst of [[Battle of Yinchorr (Yinchorri Uprising)|battle]] Koth led the offensive as they paved a way to Windu's group on foot. Once they met with Windu, Master Koth led the retreat back to the ship where they found Padawan [[Theen Fida]] dead. Carrying the [[Anx/Legends|Anx's]] body aboard the ship with Master Gallia, Koth and the others sensed the death of fellow Councilor Micah Giiett through the Force. Making their way into space the Jedi's ship was attacked, but with the help of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], the Jedi landed in the Yinchorri command center and ended the conflict. Leaving the situation in the hands of the Navy and [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]], Master Koth and his comrades returned to Coruscant.<ref name="JCAOW" />

====Return of the Sith====
[[File:Eeth_Koth_TPM.png|thumb|left|250px|Koth in his seat on the Jedi Council.]]
When the High Council discovered that the terrorist group known as the [[Jin'ha]] were synthesizing [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] ore on the planet [[Obredaan]], Masters Koth and Plo Koon were dispatched to investigate and put an end to the production of the illegal substance. While on planet the Masters were discovered by the terrorists and captured; the Council immediately sent Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his Padawan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when they lost communications with the two Councilors. Master Jinn was able to locate the Masters in a holding facility and released them, joining his Padawan at the synthesizing facility to defeat the terrorists there. After the fighting and the destruction of the facility, Master Koth joined his comrades in witnessing a [[Trade Federation gunship]] fly over the planet, something that seemed to support Master Adi Gallia's reports of illegal Federation activity. Koth later had a lightsaber duel with Kenobi in the Jedi Temple, with Kenobi proving successful.<ref name="Star Wars: Obi-Wan video game">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref>

Around this time Master Koth and [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] entered into the [[Concordance of Fealty]], exchanging their lightsabers for a duration of time as an act of trust.<ref name="ETM">''[[Star Wars: Emissaries to Malastare]]''</ref> Koth was on Coruscant soon after when Master Jinn brought news of a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] Zabrak [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]] that had attacked him on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The assassin was highly skilled with a lightsaber and wield the Force as a weapon, leading Jinn to believe that the man was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Startled by this revelation, the Council was even more surprised by Jinn's claim to have discovered a vergence in the Force, centered around a boy named [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The Council agreed to test the boy and judge whether he would be trained; while Master Koth saw himself in the nine year old, the majority of the Council voted that Skywalker was to old to begin the training. When reports came in that Master Jinn had been slain on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the Zabrak assassin, Koth and the majority of the Council traveled to the world for his [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|funeral]] and to be briefed by his surviving Padawan. Padawan Kenobi detailed the duel fought between Jinn, the Zabrak, and himself, leaving little doubt that the Dark Sider was indeed a Sith. While Kenobi managed to kill him the Council was deeply disturbed that the Sith had survived and decided to knight Kenobi and appoint Skywalker as his apprentice.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Shortly after the crisis on Naboo, Master Koth assigned Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] to track down the nearly reemerged Sharad Hett on Tatooine. Because the Council had decided Koth's connection to Hett was too strong for him to act effectively, the rest of the Council agreed on the assignment for Mundi.<ref name="SWRO" /> Immediately before the Jedi delegation left for [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Masters Windu and Koth concluded the Concordance of Fealty and returned each others weapons as well as their trust in each other.<ref name="ETM" />

Several years later in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Master Koth agreed to travel to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to prevent a possible terrorist plot by the renegade [[Annoo-dat]] general [[Ashaar Khorda]]. The attack however did not come to Alderaan, instead Master [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]] was able to defeat the general on Coruscant itself, but not without sacrificing himself.<ref name="Star Wars: Zam Wesell">''[[Star Wars: Zam Wesell]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
[[File:EethKoth-SWE.png|thumb|right|175px|Eeth Koth around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Clone Wars]]

====Battle of Geonosis====
Koth was present on Coruscant when Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, reported on the failed [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination plot]] against [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Over the next few days the Council was made aware that Kenobi had been captured on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] and was in need of rescue from his would-be executioner. Joining Master Windu's [[Jedi assault team/Legends|task force]], Master Koth and his fellow Jedi [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|fought]] through the [[Petranaki arena]] cutting down the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] in what became the opening battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the surviving Jedi were surrounded by their mechanized foes, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] gave the order to fire. However, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and rescued the Jedi. Boarding one of several [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] that landed in the arena, Master Koth was accompanied by Masters [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] and [[Tarados Gon/Legends|Tarados Gon]] and took off to take the battle to the plains. While in transit the Jedi's gunship was hit by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] artillery fire and brought down.<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> While both Koth<ref name="DB" /> and Bulq<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu">''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]''</ref> barely survived the attack, only Koth was rescued by the Republic, unwittingly leaving Bulq, who was thought dead, to fend for himself.<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones" /><ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|sorabulq|Bulq, Sora}}</ref><ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" />

Following his return to Coruscant, Master Koth returned to active duty and was dispatched by the Council to lead a squad of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Battle of Korriban (Clone Wars)|Battle]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. While the squad suffered startling [[Death/Legends|casualties]], Master Koth made it out alive and returned to Coruscant soon after.<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>

====Grievous's prisoner====
{{Quote|Eeth Koth, isn't it? I've been looking forward to meeting you.''"<br />"''Your reputation precedes you, General&mdash;the reputation of a coward and a murderer.''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Murderer?'' Is it murder to rid the galaxy of you Jedi filth?|Eeth Koth and General Grievous|audio=CowardAndMurderer-GI.flac|<ref name="Grievous Intrigue">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref>}}
[[File:Eeth_Koth_TCW.png|thumb|left|250px|Eeth Koth about to face Grievous on board the ''Steadfast''.]]
Later dispatched to the Outer Rim once more, Koth was given command of a task force charged with hunting down Separatist raiders attacking shipping lanes. Near the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]],<ref name="FF-2014 21">{{FactFile2014|21|21 BBY 3-6|Intrigues in the Outer Rim}}</ref> Master Koth's fleet was engaged by the [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who proceeded to board the Jedi's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator'']]-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Steadfast (Venator-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']]. Koth, stationed on the bridge, ordered [[Lock (Clone Captain)/Legends|Captain Lock]] and his troopers to flee in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] while he remained on board and dealt with the General. As Grievous cut his way to the bridge, Koth stood ready for the upcoming battle, emerging himself deeper and deeper in the Force. As Grievous burst into the chamber his [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] rushed the Zabrak Jedi and opened fire on the troopers that remained on the bridge. Slaughtering all the troopers save one while Koth engaged some of the commandos, Koth took a blaster bolt to the arm as four [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] stepped into the fray. Killing the last clone, the droids surround Koth as Grievous watched, brandishing their [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] at the outnumbered Jedi. Believing his enemy to be subdued, Grievous at last came forth and taunted Koth before kicking him backwards a few feet across the bridge. Engaging the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] in combat, Koth was forced on the defensive but still fought valiantly despite his injured arm. He eventually used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|shove]] the general into a window before charging towards him. However, Koth was quickly taken out of the fight by the MagnaGuards who electrocuted him several times before he was swiftly seized into a chokehold by a triumphant Grievous.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

[[File:Koth_tortured.png|thumb|right|250px|Eeth Koth tortured via electrocution by TV-94]]
Taking Koth [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|captive]], Grievous intended to slowly torture the renowned Jedi to death. In typical fashion, Grievous sent a transmission to the Coruscant Temple to gloat over the Councilor's capture, depicting a weakened Koth being tortured by his MagnaGuads. The cyborg's self-indulgent message was his undoing as Koth was able to communicate his coordinates using [[Sign language/Legends|sign language]] that was picked up by the members of the High Council. Recognizing the coordinates as that of the [[Saleucami system/Legends|Saleucami system]], the Council dispatched Masters Kenobi, Gallia, and Jedi Skywalker to rescue Koth.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

Koth had no way of knowing that Grievous had captured him for the purpose of baiting the other Jedi. As such, the cyborg had prepared the inevitable confrontation.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

Boarding Grievous' ship secretly, Gallia and Skywalker were able to rescue the Master relatively easy as Master Kenobi engaged Grievous elsewhere on the ship. As they made their escape, the group was surrounded by a group of droid commandos. Enduring the taunts of the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], [[TV-94/Legends|TV-94]], Gallia and Skywalker destroyed all of the droids including TV-94 and the Jedi raced to their ship before Grievous returned. While Skywalker continued on with the Zabrak, Gallia rushed to slow the general so as to provide cover for her allies. After a brief duel, Grievous disengaged from the battle with the [[Tholothian]] Jedi and took for the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], leaving Gallia to rendezvous with her comrades and escape the doomed CIS flagship. Returning Koth's lightsaber to him, Master Kenobi and Jedi Skywalker parted ways with the two Councilors as Gallia escorted Koth to a medical frigate.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" />

Later in the Clone Wars, Master Koth's [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] was present in the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] when it received an ancient Jedi distress code. The Council decided to send Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano to [[Mission to Mortis/Legends|investigate]].<ref name="Overlords">{{TCW|Overlords}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
A devout member of the Order, Koth had strong ties to his fellow Masters, but no bond was stronger than between him and his former Padawan, [[Sharad Hett]]. Master Koth's relationship with Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was strengthened through their completion of the Jedi ritual known as the [[Concordance of Fealty]] shortly after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

The name "[[Eeth]]" was common among Zabrak males and meant "fearless".<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:Koth_lightsaber.png|thumb|left|250px|Eeth Koth's lightsaber.]]
Trained as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]], Koth was a talented swordsman and tactician, wielding a lightsaber with a green [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] to produce its emerald blade. Capable of wielding the Force proficiently, Master Koth's greatest strengths lay in his natural ability to hone his mind into a disciplined weapon.<ref name="TCSWE" /> He was an extremely skilled duelist, capable of holding off the ferocious style of infamous Jedi-killer General Grievous, despite being forced on the defensive and having to wield his lightsaber one-handed due to an injury to his forearm. At the conclusion of their duel, Koth demonstrated proficiency with unleashing powerful [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetic]] blasts, which he used to temporarily subdue the Confederate General.<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> While in the Jedi Temple, he was also known to use a green [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] in sparring bouts with his fellow Jedi.<ref name="TCWA:LD">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>

Common to his species was an innate ability to endure great physical pain, a trait developed as a way to survive the harsh wilds of [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. Enhanced through his connection to the Force and his Jedi training, Koth was a master of the rare [[Force power/Legends|technique]] known as [[Crucitorn (technique)|Crucitorn]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Now, we're going to get into a detail here. You know, there's the whole thing, 'Dave, is Eeth Koth still alive? 'Cause I thought he was on a gunship, in Geonosis.' [&hellip;] I didn't see him die.|Dave Filoni, after resurrecting Eeth Koth's character|<ref name="videocommentary">{{SW|url=video/grievous-intrigue-episode-featurette|text="Grievous Intrigue" Episode Featurette}}</ref>}}
Eeth Koth was created by ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] as a member of the Jedi Council in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. In the initial development of the character, Koth was slated to be the leader of the Council. In the film, he was played by [[Hassani Shapi]].<ref name="DB" />

[[File:EethKothAgenKolarAnimated.jpg|left|thumb|Agen Kolar's appearance in ''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' was animated with Eeth Koth's likeness]]Koth was slated to appear in [[2002]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], but as the majority of the film was being shot in Australia, local actor [[Tux Akindoyeni]] was used to play the character. Archival footage of Shapi from Episode I was used for scenes involving the Jedi Council, while Akindoyeni portrayed the character during the Battle of Geonosis. However, visual differences between the two incarnations of Koth prompted [[Lucasfilm]] to establish Akindoyeni's character as [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], a second Zabrak Jedi Master.<ref name="DB" /> Kolar went on to appear in [[2005]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], while Koth did not;<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> most production paperwork for Episodes II and III referred to Kolar as Koth, however.<ref name="DB" /><ref name="makingrots">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref><ref name="illustrated">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> A Zabrak Jedi High Council member that appeared in two episodes of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' was animated with Koth's likeness, despite being credited as Kolar. A [[2009]] update to Koth's [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]] later stated that Koth's character design appeared in ''Clone Wars''.<ref name="DB" />

''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', published in [[2003]], stated that Koth died during the Battle of Geonosis when his gunship was brought down by enemy fire.<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones" /> However, Koth was mentioned as fighting in the Clone Wars in the [[2008]] novel [[The Clone Wars: Wild Space|''Wild Space'']].<ref name="Wild Space" /> When "[[Grievous Intrigue]]," a [[2010]] episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' was being written, series supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] wanted to use Koth, but was told by both [[Leland Chee]], keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database]], and [[Pablo Hidalgo]], Internet Content Manager for [[Lucas Online]], that the character was dead. Filoni then received permission from George Lucas to resurrect the character. Koth had been slated to die at the beginning of "Grievous Intrigue", but Filoni decided that he was an interesting enough character to use in future episodes of the series.<ref name="videocommentary" /> In the episode, Koth was voiced by actor [[Chris Edgerly]],<ref name="Grievous Intrigue" /> who gave the character a soft [[Wikipedia:Indian English|Indian]] accent that he identified as tricky to do, yet gracious and noble.<ref name="edgerly">{{SWArchive|url=fans/rocks/news20100101.html|text=Chris Edgerly: From Potamus to Koth}}</ref>
